if otohaspecial15p2 == True:
scene otohasummer2streetsgenhair
else:
scene otohasummer2streetsgen
I make my way over to the park to see what Otoha’s up to and, as always, she’s busy busking and causing any woman who passes by to immediately fall in love with her.
lines.zh: 我走到公园去看看 Otoha 在干什么，而一如既往，她正忙着街头卖艺，并且让每一个路过的女人立刻爱上她。

lines.en: I think to myself for a moment about which direction {i}my{/i} life would head in if I were to take up an instrument and spend my days trying to impress women.
lines.zh: 我琢磨了一会儿，要是我去学一门乐器、每天想着怎么讨女人欢心，{i}我{/i}的人生会朝哪个方向走。

lines.en: But then I remember that I’m able to impress them without any notable skills at all, so I discard the idea and make my way over to the bench and wait for Otoha to finish playing.
lines.zh: 但接着我想起来，我根本不需要任何拿得出手的本事就能讨她们欢心，于是我打消了这个念头，走到长椅那儿坐下，等 Otoha 弹完。

lines.en: Once the last of her spectators disperse, she packs her guitar up and signals to me that I am cool enough to approach her.
lines.zh: 等最后一批观众散去，她把吉他收好，向我示意我已经够酷、可以过来了。

lines.en: I thank her for taking time out of her busy schedule to spend on a nobody like me and then proceed to tease her about more things along those lines because she hates it and making her mad is fun.
lines.zh: 我感谢她从繁忙的日程里挤出时间，花在我这样一个无名小卒身上，然后继续拿这一类的事情逗她，因为她讨厌这个，而把她惹毛很好玩。

lines.en: scene black
We do several laps around the park before heading over to the cafe to kill the rest of the morning there.
lines.zh: 我们绕着公园走了好几圈，然后去咖啡厅把上午剩下的时间打发掉。

lines.en: Or, at least that’s the reasoning we verbalize. In all actuality, Otoha probably just wants to hang out with Rin and I am becoming a nuisance.
lines.zh: 至少我们嘴上是这么说的。实际上，Otoha 大概只是想跟 Rin 待在一起，而我正变得越来越碍事。

lines.en: But hey, I’m fine with being a nuisance as long as I can be one around attractive girls, so I decide against pushing her buttons in {i}this{/i} regard as it will soon prove beneficial to me.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，只要能在一群漂亮的女孩身边碍事，我乐意当个碍事的人，所以我决定{i}在{/i}这方面不去戳她的痛处，因为它很快就会对我有好处。

lines.en: When we finally make it to Koi Cafe, I’m pleasantly surprised to find that I am not immediately converted into a third wheel and that I am actually able to stay involved in conversations.
lines.zh: 等我们终于到了 Koi Cafe，我惊喜地发现自己并没有立刻变成电灯泡，而且实际上还插得上话。

lines.en: Unfortunately, that doesn’t really do much for the subconscious feeling that I’m interrupting something by being here.
lines.zh: 可惜，这并没有怎么缓解那种"我在这儿是在打扰什么"的潜意识感觉。

lines.en: So after hanging around for a short while longer, I grab a coffee to-go and take my leave.
lines.zh: 于是又待了一会儿之后，我买了杯外带咖啡，起身告辞。

{i}Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!{/i}
